card.text: Explore Jupiter in 3D with cssEarth. Discover the solar system’s largest planet, its colorful cloud bands, giant storms, and orbiting moons.

introduction.text: The fifth planet from the Sun, Jupiter is the solar system's largest planet: a gas giant wrapped in colorful clouds and enormous storms.

normal.title: WFC3 visible-color map
normal.summary: Cloud detail combines a 2019 global map with separate polar images. The poles are illustrative and not aligned to its longitudes.

ultraviolet.title: OPAL F275W map
ultraviolet.summary: False colors represent 275 nm reflectance measured in December 2025. The gray grid marks missing observations.

methane.title: OPAL FQ889N map
methane.summary: False colors represent 889 nm reflectance measured in December 2025. The gray grid marks missing observations.
